user.title: Plooum CamPreview
user.description: Pick the cameras to keep a regular, filtered preview of, with the default settings. Add more later with "Add camera", each with its own settings.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Plooum CamPreview is already set up: add cameras from its entry ("Add camera").

data.rebase_count: Pictures alike to adopt a new view (0: never)

data_description.black_level: A picture whose brightest parts (98th percentile) are darker than this is black and ignored.
data_description.min_contrast: A picture flatter than this (luminance standard deviation) is uniform ("no signal" screen) and ignored.
data_description.match_threshold: A picture whose edges look less like the usual view than this is ignored: the camera turned.
data_description.rebase_count: When this many ignored pictures in a row look alike, the camera points somewhere else for good: the new view is adopted.
data_description.max_age_hours: Last resort: after this long without any accepted picture (black ones aside), the latest one is taken.

update.name: Update preview
update.description: Captures a picture now. Forced, it is taken whatever it shows and becomes the camera's new usual view.

force.name: Force
force.description: Skip the filters and adopt the picture as the new view.
